The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4b9f1ff903605ffa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. statement: After compatible nonzero scalar normalizations, the auxiliary coefficient spectral sequence has d1(u) = uz0, d1(e) = ez0, d1(zi) = ziz0 (i = 1, 2), d1(z0) = 0. Consequently E2 = k[b±1 , u±3 , N0, N1, N2] ⊗ Λ(eu, z1u, z2u, z0). (3.3) Its only nonzero differential on these generators is d2(z0) = c bN0, c ∈ k× . There are no further differentials. In particular the leading cohomology class eu is represented by an actual element x0 ∈ E−2 satisfying x0/u ≡ 1 (mod m), TrH(x0) = 0. The element x0 may be chosen of T-weight one.
